purpose: Test the remaining cross-aspect question after Pair2 settlement while preserving the six-control compact module strictly as a photo-only mechanism candidate. Change aspect from 3:4 to 9:16 while holding renderer, reference, tofu subject/process class, one-image budget and blind evaluation structure symmetric.

scope_review.rationale: Both photo-only blind replications favored Route B at MEDIUM confidence, so deleting validated photo-only controls now would discard supported mechanism evidence. Pair2 only narrows their claim boundary: they are not supported as an end-to-end complete-poster advantage.

shared_image_task: Create exactly one photo-only 9:16 portrait image of a real traditional tofu workshop in early morning. The scene must visibly contain pale soybeans or freshly made white tofu, natural pressing cloths, aged wooden tofu molds or pressing frames, a stone/plaster washing or soaking trough, and a modest preparation/pressing table with believable signs of active food production. Use restrained documentary photography, cool-neutral morning daylight, realistic wet/dry material differences, worn wood and cloth, and one natural quiet low-detail area that could later hold typography. Keep the scene primarily interior; do not use mountains, forest scenery, or a picturesque outdoor view as a compositional shortcut. Compose natively for a tall 9:16 frame: the spatial zones and near/mid/far relationships must structurally reflow rather than looking like a simple crop, stretch, stack, or centered-vertical fallback from a 3:4 composition. Do not include any people as the main subject, beauty/wellness products, bottles, cosmetics, supplements, laptops, home-office lifestyle scenes, tea ware, wok/fire, logos, labels, calligraphy, readable text, advertising copy, detached graphic panels, or invented brands. Use the attached R1C image only for overall visual family feeling and relational balance; do not copy its subject, brand, text, motifs, palette literally, or layout coordinates.

mechanism_controls: One dominant material mass counterbalanced by a scene-created quiet tonal pocket.
Clear first-second-third read through dominant mass, depth layer and supporting process detail.
Concentrate high material detail regionally; keep the typography pocket visually low-density.
Preserve truthful near/mid/far depth rather than flattening the scene into a decorative still life.
Use pale tofu/soy, natural press cloth, aged wood and mineral/stone surfaces with cool-neutral shadow roles; do not copy the reference palette literally.
Bind soybeans/tofu, press cloths, molds, troughs and tools to real production/process evidence rather than decorative motifs.

correctness_gate: native tall-frame reflow; not crop-only, stretch-only, stack-only, or generic centered vertical fallback
no readable text or invented brand

evaluation.blind_mapping_method: After both exact output hashes are known, assign X/Y by lexicographic ascending SHA-256 order.
evaluation.primary_question: Does the compact photo-only mechanism preserve hierarchy, quiet tonal pocket, regional density and truthful depth while structurally reflowing from 3:4 to 9:16?
